freePlan.limits: Up to 1M monthly tracked events, 10K session replays/month, up to 1K experiment MEU/month, up to 10 active feature flags, unlimited seats.

keyLimits.en: Up to 1M events/month, 10K session replays/month, funnels and retention analysis, unlimited seats.
Up to 20M events/month included, then volume-based pricing; up to 500K session replays/month, 5K experiment MEU included, up to 50 active feature flags, unlimited saved cohorts, up to 5 alerts.
Up to 1T events/month, custom session replay and experiment volumes, unlimited alerts, anomaly detection, root cause analysis, Metric Trees, dedicated success team.

cautions.en: Growth plan starts free but bills on volume beyond the included 20M monthly events; the entry paid price point depends on actual event volume rather than a flat listed rate.
Pricing model changed from monthly tracked users (MTU) to monthly events as the primary billing metric; older MTU-based pricing (used in the seed data) is outdated.

capabilities.en: Product analytics with funnels, retention analysis and custom event tracking.
Session replay integrated into the same platform, with volume tiers per plan.
Feature flags and experimentation (MEU-based) built into the product.
Anomaly detection, root cause analysis and Metric Trees on Enterprise.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 1M events/month and 10 active feature flags, limiting use for higher-traffic products.
Growth plan's exact price beyond the included event volume is not a flat published number, making budgeting less predictable.

reason.en: Already listed as a current alternative; direct competitor in product analytics.
Already listed as a current alternative; broader web analytics competitor.
Open-source product analytics alternative with self-hosting option.
Overlaps on session replay and behavioral analytics use cases.

unknowns: Exact per-event overage price for the Growth plan beyond the included 20M events/month not published as a flat rate.
Startup Program discount terms (first year free) not fully detailed (eligibility verification process).
conflicts: Seed pricing (comparePriceMonthlyEur 17.52, MTU-based model) reflects Mixpanel's older monthly-tracked-users pricing; the current official page prices by monthly events instead, so the seed's pricing model is outdated.
